milestones.name: Core on one server (Go; generations; Compose)

core-plan-apply.summary: M1 full CLI cycle verified on reset Ubuntu lab (TestLabM1 166.839 s on 2026-11-22, including verified semantic diff, file-path fallback and failed init rollback). OLY-30 closed selective recreation; OLY-54 adds config-key diffs in plan (YAML/TOML/JSON), hardened by OLY-65 with an escaped display and bounded config reads through the verified activator.

catalog-lock.summary: OLY-65 adds expanded-stream and archive entry budgets to catalog extraction.

activator.summary: OLY-63: run post-install hooks in the tool container after readiness. Persist success by stack tool name and roll back on failure (ADR 0052). Red/green unit tests and the extended TestLabM1 verified first apply, no-op re-apply, completion across container replacement and rollback, and hook failure rollback. OLY-67 makes selective secret recreation wait for managed init and includes orphans in teardown (ADR 0057). Both the targeted regression and TestLabM1 passed on fresh lab VMs.

recipe-format.summary: OLY-55 adds a validated runtime block (shm_size, stop_grace_period, no_new_privileges, seccomp) rendering fixed Compose keys; the seccomp profile is a hashed store file. Offline tests green; lab not run (no QEMU). Real three-tool lab lifecycle passed earlier: native MCP references, skills, healthy containers, no-op/selective IDs, rollback and delete-data teardown.

first-recipes.summary: Real three-tool lab lifecycle passed: native MCP references, skills, healthy containers, no-op/selective IDs, rollback and delete-data teardown. Hermes pinned to v0.22.7.

shared-mcps-skills.summary: Real three-tool lab lifecycle passed: native MCP references, skills, healthy containers, no-op/selective IDs, rollback and delete-data teardown.

channels.summary: Hermes Telegram and Discord render as environment variables with a required allow-list. Telegram allow entries corrected to numeric user IDs (usernames match nobody upstream). Live bot test pending.

recipe-catalog.summary: OLY-65 makes generated init fail on the first managed-file copy error. Recipes added with golden tests (TestRecipeGoldens / TestOpenBotGolden): OpenBot (OLY-56), Claude Code (OLY-19), Gemini CLI (OLY-20), Goose (OLY-23), Aider (OLY-24), OpenClaw (OLY-21), Pi (OLY-22) and Oh My Pi (OLY-22). Remote MCP renders per tool since OLY-57. Pi installs from a committed package-lock.json and Oh My Pi ships a checksum-verified binary from a fetch stage (ADR 0051). Goose, Aider and OpenClaw declare no MCP (format gap / no MCP client). Lab evidence: Pi (2026-11-21) and, from OLY-52 on 2026-11-22, Aider, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw and Oh My Pi. OLY-52 re-checked all remaining README claims against pinned sources, corrected false statements and kept only truly unverified live model/bot/browser/MCP connections. OLY-25: no Grok bot recipe; the catalog name has no clear referent (see Sources/landscape.md). OLY-66 disables npm lifecycle scripts in the claude-code, codex and gemini-cli builds; fresh single-tool lab applies with sentinel secrets passed for all three with pinned --version output, and TestLabRealStack passed with the new Codex build (ADR 0056).

test-lab.summary: OLY-32: TestLabDeploy and TestLabM1 passed on fresh amd64 QEMU guests for Ubuntu 22.04 and Debian 12 (and TestLabM1 on Ubuntu 24.04 after the seed-mode change). TestLabTwoServers passed on two fresh Ubuntu 24.04 VMs with matching generation IDs, manifest bytes, running image and platform manifest digests, and config hashes (registry-pulled fixtures). The Linux arm64 build passed; arm64 runtime, real VPS and macOS validation remain open. The 2026-11-21 Ubuntu 24.04 results also covered TestLabRealStack with Hermes, Codex and OpenCode.

deploy.summary: OLY-68 versions readable non-secret tool store entries and gives managed-copy init services the tool's security options (ADR 0058). Offline validation, the fresh-VM M1 cycle, and the UID 1000 OpenClaw apply and file checks passed.

preflight.summary: Read-only preflight in plan/apply: OS, arch vs locked image platforms, RAM, disk and occupied ports (ignoring the current olympus generation). Offline tests only; lab not run (no QEMU on this host).

release-pipeline.summary: Cross-compile CLI and Linux activator, SHA256SUMS, activator checksum verification against release (A12), tag-triggered release workflow and build provenance. OLY-61 adds an explicit -unsafe-dev-activator opt-in for development builds without a release checksum. Live release verification remains pending.

security-review.summary: OLY-33 source review documented. OLY-61 fixes F3: development builds require -unsafe-dev-activator for an activator with no release checksum; release builds unchanged. Security data-flow note added in docs/security/data-flow.md. OLY-62 fixes F2 offline: npm recipes install from committed lockfiles with npm ci and Goose ships only its verified binary (no image built yet). OLY-66 resolves 2026-11-22 review R5: npm lifecycle scripts disabled in all three npm-built recipes, with audited explicit Claude Code postinstall; lab applies passed with sentinel secrets (ADR 0056). F1 live checks, remaining 2026-11-22 findings and F4 remain open.

user-docs.summary: OLY-35: user-facing documentation including Quickstart in README.md, command-by-command reference in docs/usage/commands.md derived strictly from CLI output, stack.yaml reference in docs/usage/stack-reference.md derived from JSON Schema and spec, and complete full-stack example in examples/full-stack/stack.yaml.

lint-baseline.summary: Cleared all remaining lint baseline findings across the entire codebase (0 issues on whole-tree golangci-lint run). Resolved final 17 findings in internal/activate, internal/deploy, internal/eval, internal/remote; verified with full offline suite, TestLabDeploy, and TestLabM1 on fresh Ubuntu 24.04 QEMU lab VM.
